profile.name: INHECO孵育振荡器堆叠系统
profile.description: 由多个可堆叠孵育振荡单元组成的实验室自动化设备，带有装载托盘，可对样品或微孔板进行温度控制孵育与振荡混匀，常用于自动化培养、反应孵育和样品处理流程。
profile.description_en: A laboratory automation device composed of multiple stackable incubator/shaker units with loading trays, used to provide temperature-controlled incubation and shaking for samples or microplates in automated culture, reaction incubation, and sample-processing workflows.
